appearances.title: Strata 0.2.11: support for Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next quants and layer splitting for every configuration
appearances.summary: The Strata local inference app shipped v0.2.11. It adds support for Unsloth's new Dynamic v3.1 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GGUF quants (seven 1 to 4 bit variants, for example UD-IQ1_M at 68 GB), allows layer splitting in all configurations, and brings speed and app/terminal improvements. Daniel Han of Unsloth confirmed the UDv3.1 quants run in Strata, including UDv3.1 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GGUFs.

appearances.title: Strata 0.2.10 runs Qwen3.8 Flash Next on 8GB cards
appearances.summary: Strata 0.2.10 runs Qwen3.8 Flash Next at more than 20 tokens per second on an 8GB graphics card with 128K context, and makes DFlash2 the default drafter. The release also adds an all-cards multi-GPU split on Linux, an ISTA-DAS coding cut of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and DeepSeek image input on Apple Silicon.
